setup: Linux, local Chrome through Browser Harness, TypeSafe jev-latest, text helper gemini-2.5-flash-lite (free tier) for every arm. Timing starts at the first decision; setup and the independent check are outside the clock.

arms.baseline: f085130 source (owned tab is a background tab in the user's window)
arms.basewin: f085130 source plus only the own-window change
arms.settle_only: this change without the own-window fix (batches 1-2)
arms.candidate: this change: own window, post-input settle, event-driven WAIT, no redundant freshness read

tasks.flights: Google Flights, one-way Zurich to London on 2026-10-20; checks route, one-way, date, year, and matching results
tasks.wiki: Open Godel's incompleteness theorems from Wikipedia's main page; checks the exact article URL
tasks.hotel: Local fixture: Lisbon, Design, Free cancellation, open Casa Flora; checks URL and applied filters

excluded: Runs whose text helper returned HTTP 429 (free-tier quota) are kept here with quota=true and excluded from the README table.
